<USER_REQUEST>
# Cake N Flowers — Project Documentation

## 1. Project Overview

A fullstack e-commerce website for a cake and flower delivery business, inspired by cakenflowers.com but with a distinct, fancier visual identity. Customers browse cakes/flowers/gifts, customize orders, check out with real payments, schedule delivery, and track orders. Admins manage products, orders, inventory, and customers via a dashboard.

**Target differentiators from the reference site:**
- More editorial, boutique-style visual design (not a generic e-commerce template)
- Smoother product customization flow (e.g., cake flavor/size/message builder)
- Cleaner, faster checkout
- Real-time order status tracking for customers

---

## 2. Tech Stack

| Layer | Choice | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Frontend | React (Vite) | SPA with React Router |
| Styling | Tailwind CSS + custom design tokens | For the "fancy" look — custom fonts, colors, motion |
| Backend | Node.js + Express | REST API |
| Database | PostgreSQL | Relational — products, orders, users, inventory |
| ORM | Prisma | Type-safe queries, migrations |
| Auth | JWT + bcrypt | Customer accounts + admin roles |
| Payments | Stripe | Checkout Sessions or Payment Intents |
| Image storage | Cloudinary or S3 | Product photos, custom cake images |
| Hosting | Frontend: Vercel/Netlify · Backend: Render/Railway · DB: Neon/Supabase/Railway Postgres | Free-tier friendly to start |
| Email | Resend or SendGrid | Order confirmations, delivery updates |

---

## 3. Core Features

### Customer-facing
- Home page (hero, featured products, occasions/categories)
- Product catalog (Cakes, Flowers, Combos, Gifts) with filters (occasion, price, flavor, size)
- Product detail page with customization (size, flavor, flowers type, add a message card, upload photo for photo cakes)
- Cart (persistent, guest + logged-in)
- Checkout: delivery address, delivery date/time slot, payment via Stripe
- Order confirmation + email receipt
- User account: order history, saved addresses, order tracking status
- Search
- Reviews/ratings on products
- Occasion-based landing pages (Birthday, Anniversary, Wedding, Sympathy, etc. — matches cakenflowers.com structure)
- Contact / custom order request form
- Same-day / scheduled delivery indicator based on pincode/zip + cutoff time

### Admin-facing
- Login (role-protected)
- Dashboard: sales overview, recent orders
- Product management: create/edit/delete, images, pricing, stock, categories
- Order management: view, update status (pending → confirmed → out for delivery → delivered), refunds
- Customer list
- Coupon/discount code management
- Inventory alerts (low stock)

---

## 4. Database Schema (high-level)

**users** — id, name, email, password_hash, role (customer/admin), created_at

**addresses** — id, user_id, label, street, city, state, zip, phone

**categories** — id, name, slug, type (cake/flower/gift/combo)

**products** — id, name, slug, description, base_price, category_id, images[], is_customizable, stock, active

**product_variants** — id, product_id, name (e.g. "1kg", "Red Roses x12"), price_modifier

**orders** — id, user_id, status, subtotal, delivery_fee, total, delivery_date, delivery_slot, address_id, payment_status, stripe_payment_id, created_at

**order_items** — id, order_id, product_id, variant_id, quantity, custom_message, custom_image_url, price_at_purchase

**reviews** — id, product_id, user_id, rating, comment, created_at

**coupons** — id, code, discount_type, discount_value, valid_from, valid_to, active

---

## 5. API Structure (REST)

```
/api/auth          POST /register, /login, /me
/api/products       GET /, GET /:slug, POST, PUT /:id, DELETE /:id (admin)
/api/categories     GET /
/api/cart           GET /, POST /add, PUT /update, DELETE /remove
/api/orders         POST /  (create + Stripe session), GET /:id, GET /my-orders
/api/admin/orders   GET /, PUT /:id/status
/api/admin/dashboard GET /stats
/api/reviews        GET /product/:id, POST /
/api/coupons        POST /validate
/api/webhooks       POST /stripe  (payment confirmation)
```

---

## 6. Folder Structure

```
cake-n-flowers/
├── frontend/
│   ├── src/
│   │   ├── components/
│   │   ├── pages/
│   │   ├── context/       (cart, auth)
│   │   ├── hooks/
│   │   ├── api/           (axios calls)
│   │   └── styles/
├── backend/
│   ├── src/
│   │   ├── routes/
│   │   ├── controllers/
│   │   ├── middleware/    (auth, error handling)
│   │   ├── prisma/        (schema.prisma, migrations)
│   │   └── utils/
├── docs/
└── README.md
```

---

## 7. Design Direction ("fancy and different")

- Typography: pair an elegant serif (headings) with a clean sans-serif (body) — e.g. Playfair Display / Cormorant + Inter
- Color palette: move away from generic red/pink — consider blush, cream, sage green, gold accents
- Motion: subtle scroll animations, hover reveals on product cards
- Imagery: large, editorial-style photography rather than cramped grids
- Custom illustrated icons instead of stock icon packs
- I can generate an actual visual mockup/homepage design once we get to the design phase — just ask

---

## 8. Development Phases / Roadmap

| Phase | Deliverable |
|---|---|
| 1. Planning | This document, wireframes, schema finalized |
| 2. Design | Homepage + product page + checkout UI mockups |
| 3. Backend setup | DB schema, auth, product/order APIs |
| 4. Frontend build | Pages wired to API, cart, checkout flow |
| 5. Payments integration | Stripe test mode → live mode |
| 6. Admin panel | Product/order management UI |
| 7. Testing | Manual QA, edge cases (payment failures, stock issues) |
| 8. Deployment | Hosting, domain, env vars, go live |

---

## 9. Open Decisions
- Payment provider region/currency (Stripe availability depends on country)
- Delivery logistics: real-time courier API integration, or manual admin-managed delivery?
- Guest checkout allowed, or account required?
</USER_REQUEST>

# Implementation Plan — Cake N Flowers Boutique E-Commerce

A fullstack boutique e-commerce web platform for luxury cake, flower, combo, and artisanal gift delivery. Inspired by the market breadth of reference delivery services but elevated with an editorial aesthetic, bespoke product customization flow, streamlined checkout with delivery slot scheduling, real-time order tracking, and a comprehensive admin management panel.

## User Review Required

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Database & Environment Recommendation**:
> Since PostgreSQL is not running locally as a system service, we propose configuring Prisma to seamlessly support both:
> 1. **PostgreSQL** for Production/Staging (via Neon, Supabase, or Railway serverless Postgres connection string in `.env`).
> 2. **SQLite / In-Memory Mock mode** as an instant local fallback so development and testing can begin immediately without waiting for database provisioning.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Workspace Recommendation**:
> The project files will be created in `C:\Users\karth\.gemini\antigravity\scratch\cake-n-flowers`. We recommend opening or setting this directory as your active workspace in your IDE or editor.

## Open Questions

> [!NOTE]
> **1. Currency & Default Locale**:
> What default currency should be pre-configured for the boutique storefront?
> - Option A: **USD ($)**
> - Option B: **INR (₹)**
> - Option C: **GBP (£) / EUR (€) / AED (AED)**
> *(Note: The codebase will support easy switching via a single environment variable `VITE_CURRENCY`).*

> [!NOTE]
> **2. Checkout Mode**:
> Should customers be permitted to check out as a **Guest** (with optional "save details for next time"), or is creating an account strictly required prior to placing an order?
> - *(Recommended: Guest checkout with automatic order tracking link via email/SMS, which minimizes cart abandonment).*

> [!NOTE]
> **3. Delivery Logistics Approach**:
> Should delivery slots follow an automated cutoff-based schedule (e.g., Morning 9 AM–1 PM, Afternoon 1 PM–6 PM, Express Same-Day 6 PM–9 PM, Midnight 11 PM–12 AM with same-day cutoff times) managed in the admin dashboard, or do you have a specific third-party courier API (e.g. Shiprocket, Dunzo, Uber Direct) to plug in immediately?

---

## Proposed Changes

### Phase 1: Project Initialization & Architecture Scaffolding

Set up the monorepo structure in `C:\Users\karth\.gemini\antigravity\scratch\cake-n-flowers` with separate `backend/` and `frontend/` folders.

---

### Backend (`cake-n-flowers/backend`)

#### [NEW] [package.json](file:///C:/Users/karth/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/cake-n-flowers/backend/package.json)
- Express, `@prisma/client`, `prisma`, `bcryptjs`, `jsonwebtoken`, `cors`, `dotenv`, `stripe`, `multer` (for photo cake uploads), `express-validator`.

#### [NEW] [prisma/schema.prisma](file:///C:/Users/karth/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/cake-n-flowers/backend/prisma/schema.prisma)
- **User**: `id`, `name`, `email`, `password_hash`, `role` (CUSTOMER, ADMIN), `phone`, `createdAt`.
- **Address**: `id`, `userId`, `label`, `recipientName`, `street`, `landmark`, `city`, `state`, `zip`, `phone`.
- **Category**: `id`, `name`, `slug`, `type` (CAKE, FLOWER, COMBO, GIFT), `image`, `description`.
- **Product**: `id`, `name`, `slug`, `description`, `basePrice`, `categoryId`, `images` (JSON/string array), `isCustomizable`, `hasPhotoUpload`, `stock`, `active`, `ratingAvg`, `reviewsCount`.
- **ProductVariant**: `id`, `productId`, `name` (e.g., "500g", "1kg", "12 Stems", "24 Stems Premium"), `priceModifier`.
- **Order**: `id`, `orderNumber`, `userId` (optional for guests), `guestEmail`, `guestPhone`, `status` (PENDING, CONFIRMED, PREPARING, OUT_FOR_DELIVERY, DELIVERED, CANCELLED), `subtotal`, `deliveryFee`, `discount`, `total`, `deliveryDate`, `deliverySlot`, `deliveryInstructions`, `recipientName`, `recipientPhone`, `shippingAddress` (JSON), `paymentStatus` (UNPAID, PAID, REFUNDED), `stripeSessionId`, `createdAt`.
- **OrderItem**: `id`, `orderId`, `productId`, `variantId`, `quantity`, `customFlavor`, `customMessageCard`, `customPhotoUrl`, `priceAtPurchase`.
- **Review**: `id`, `productId`, `userId`, `userName`, `rating`, `comment`, `createdAt`.

datasource db {
  provider = "sqlite"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

model User {
  id           String    @id @default(uuid())
  name         String
  email        String    @unique
  passwordHash String
  role         String    @default("CUSTOMER") // CUSTOMER, ADMIN
  phone        String?
  createdAt    DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt    DateTime  @updatedAt
  addresses    Address[]
  orders       Order[]
  reviews      Review[]
}

model Address {
  id            String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId        String
  user          User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  label         String?  @default("Home") // Home, Work, Other
  recipientName String
  street        String
  landmark      String?
  city          String
  state         String
  zip           String
  phone         String
  isDefault     Boolean  @default(false)
  createdAt     DateTime @default(now())
}

model Category {
  id          String    @id @default(uuid())
  name        String
  slug        String    @unique
  type        String    // CAKE, FLOWER, COMBO, GIFT
  description String?
  image       String?
  products    Product[]
  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now())
}

model Product {
  id             String           @id @default(uuid())
  name           String
  slug           String           @unique
  description    String
  basePrice      Float
  categoryId     String
  category       Category         @relation(fields: [categoryId], references: [id])
  images         String           // JSON string array of image URLs
  isCustomizable Boolean          @default(false)
  hasPhotoUpload Boolean          @default(false)
  isEggless      Boolean          @default(false)
  stock          Int              @default(50)
  active         Boolean          @default(true)
  ratingAvg      Float            @default(4.9)
  reviewsCount   Int              @default(12)
  occasionTags   String?          // Comma-separated: birthday, anniversary, romance, luxury
  createdAt      DateTime         @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime         @updatedAt
  variants       ProductVariant[]
  orderItems     OrderItem[]
  reviews        Review[]
}

model ProductVariant {
  id            String      @id @default(uuid())
  productId     String
  product       Product     @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  name          String      // e.g. "500g", "1kg", "12 Stems", "Deluxe Bouquet"
  priceModifier Float       @default(0.0)
  isDefault     Boolean     @default(false)
  orderItems    OrderItem[]
}

model Order {
  id                   String      @id @default(uuid())
  orderNumber          String      @unique // e.g. CNF-2026-8941
  userId               String?
  user                 User?       @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  guestEmail           String?
  guestName            String?
  guestPhone           String?
  status               String      @default("CONFIRMED") // PENDING, CONFIRMED, PREPARING, OUT_FOR_DELIVERY, DELIVERED, CANCELLED
  subtotal             Float
  deliveryFee          Float       @default(0.0)
  discount             Float       @default(0.0)
  total                Float
  deliveryDate         String      // YYYY-MM-DD
  deliverySlot         String      // e.g. "Morning (9:00 AM - 1:00 PM)"
  deliveryInstructions String?
  recipientName        String
  recipientPhone       String
  shippingAddress      String      // JSON string of address details
  paymentStatus        String      @default("PAID") // UNPAID, PAID, REFUNDED
  paymentMethod        String      @default("STRIPE") // STRIPE, CASH_ON_DELIVERY, SIMULATED
  stripeSessionId      String?
  courierName          String?     // e.g. "Artisan Express Couriers"
  trackingNumber       String?
  notes                String?
  createdAt            DateTime    @default(now())
  updatedAt            DateTime    @updatedAt
  items                OrderItem[]
}

model OrderItem {
  id                String          @id @default(uuid())
  orderId           String
  order             Order           @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  productId         String
  product           Product         @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id])
  variantId         String?
  variant           ProductVariant? @relation(fields: [variantId], references: [id])
  variantName       String?
  quantity          Int             @default(1)
  customFlavor      String?         // e.g. "Belgian Dark Chocolate"
  customMessageCard String?         // text message on luxury card
  customPhotoUrl    String?         // for photo cakes
  customInscription String?         // text written on cake icing
  isEggless         Boolean         @default(false)
  priceAtPurchase   Float
}

model Review {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  productId String
  product   Product  @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  userId    String?
  user      User?    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  userName  String
  rating    Int      @default(5)
  comment   String
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
}

model Coupon {
  id             String    @id @default(uuid())
  code           String    @unique
  discountType   String    // PERCENTAGE, FIXED
  discountValue  Float
  minOrderAmount Float     @default(0.0)
  validFrom      DateTime  @default(now())
  validTo        DateTime?
  active         Boolean   @default(true)
  usageCount     Int       @default(0)
}

  userName  String
  rating    Int      @default(5)
  comment   String
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
}

  discountType   String

  minOrderAmount Float     @default(0.0)
  validFrom      DateTime  @default(now())
  validTo        DateTime?
  active         Boolean   @default(true)
  usageCount     Int       @default(0)
}
